_doc: Shop equipment. icon = index into assets/sprites/items/equipment.png. tool_sprite = column in assets/sprites/player/tools.png. tier = strongest block tier the tool can break. power = damage per hit. speed = swings per second multiplier.

pickaxes.name: Basic Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: A worn wooden pickaxe from the old camp.

pickaxes.name: Copper Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Breaks Reinforced Stone. Opens the way to the Iron Depths.

pickaxes.name: Iron Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Sturdy iron head. Cracks Iron-Bound Rock.

pickaxes.name: Crystal Pickaxe
pickaxes.desc: Resonates with the rock. Cuts through Permafrost Walls.

pickaxes.name: Diamond Drill
pickaxes.desc: A diamond-tipped drill that bores through Magma Shells.

pickaxes.name: Plasma Mining Tool
pickaxes.desc: Cuts anything, even Prototype Minerals and Ancient Metal.

drills.name: Portable Drill
drills.desc: Hotbar tool: damages the target and all 4 neighbours at once.

lanterns.name: Crystal Lantern
lanterns.desc: A crystal core lights the dark in cool blue.

scanners.name: Mining Scanner
scanners.desc: Pings Rare or better deposits within 14 tiles.

scanners.name: Deep Scanner
scanners.desc: Pings Uncommon or better deposits within 24 tiles and marks them on the map.

boots.name: Thermal Boots
boots.desc: Walk on Magma Crust safely and resist lava. Grips ice.

boots.name: Gravity Boots
boots.desc: No fall damage, higher jumps, heat proof.

cosmetics.name: Prospector's Crown
cosmetics.desc: Awarded for completing the Mineral Collection.

cosmetics.name: Aurora Lantern Glow
cosmetics.desc: Collection reward: your lantern glows with shifting aurora colours.

cosmetics.name: Gem Charm
cosmetics.desc: Collection reward: a sparkling gem charm on your pickaxe.

cosmetics.name: Golden Finish
cosmetics.desc: Legendary collection reward: +10% mining power and a golden pickaxe.
